Bacteria_Wilt_And_Soft_Rot.quote: Leaves turn yellow and leaflets tend to roll upwards at the margins.
Stems of infected plants typically have inky black symptoms, which usually begin at the decaying seed piece and may extend up the entire length of the stem.
Inky-black, slightly sunken lesions develop at the stem end of the tuber.
Weak, chlorotic (yellowed) plants with margins of leaflets curled upwards.

Late_Blight.quote: Blackish water soaked lesions occur on the leaves and whitish sporulation of the pathogen can be seen around the margin of the lesions, particularly on the underside of the leaf.
On stems, late blight causes brown lesions that look greasy.
The pathogen causes purplish-brown lesions on the surface of tubers.

Penicillium_Fungi.quote: After 7 days, disease symptoms on potato tubers appeared as blue green patches of mycelia when inoculated with Penicillium solitum and after 10 days, these patches transformed into black indentation with dark green patches in cross section upon dissection.

Rhizoctonia_Damping-Off.quote: Foliage may develop yellowing, purpling, and upward curling of leaves.
The fungus attacks underground sprouts before they emerge from the soil.
If tubers in affected fields are left in the ground after vine death, they often develop black scurf, an accumulation of irregular black sclerotia of R. solani on the tuber surface.
Aboveground symptoms of stem canker include uneven stands, weak shoot growth, and aerial tubers.

Southern_Blight.quote: a brown to black lesion usually develops on the stem near the soil line
white mycelium will typically develop on stem lesions and can sometimes extend several centimeters up the stem
sudden and permanent wilt of all above ground parts

Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus.quote: On potato leaves, tomato spotted wilt can lead to necrotic (i.e., dead) areas with or without yellow haloes.
Black streaks on petioles or stems and branch tip dieback are also common symptoms on potato.
Potato tuber symptoms include surface rings or dark patches, and internal discolored patches, rings, spots or flecks.
